## Probe #11 follow-up (acceptance of tip 7815439) + tagged release

Builds on **0.1.22** with the probe #10 acceptance tip and the round-11 follow-up batch.

### Probe #10 (accepted @ 7815439)
- Close Others / Close Saved / Close Editors in Group
- Replace in Files (palette + Ctrl+Shift+H)
- Auto Save, Format Document, Trim Trailing Whitespace
- Help palette aliases; Word Wrap status; Explorer ↔ Search activity bar

### Probe #11 follow-up (this release)
- **Search-view Replace** — Find + Replace fields in the Search activity sidebar; Replace / Replace All without leaving the rail (chords/prompts kept)
- **Activity bar SCM + Extensions** — four landmarks with selected state; stub panels match palette roadmap notices
- **Auto Save status** — “Auto Save” in the status bar when enabled; click toggles
- **Bulk dirty close** — ≥2 dirty targets for Close Others / Close All → one Save All / Don’t Save All / Cancel
- **Theme picker** — live preview while browsing; Esc restores the prior theme
- **Pin Tab** — File ▸ Close ▸ Pin Tab + palette “Pin Tab”; pinned glyph; Close Others leaves pins
- **Breadcrumbs** — clickable path segments for nested files
- **Outline / Symbol pane** — View ▸ Outline lists fold symbols (e.g. sample.py) and jumps on click
- **Compare / diff** — Compare with Saved and disk-conflict Compare open a two-pane hunk-navigable diff
- **Settings filter** — type `wrap` or `autosave` to filter toggles

### Deferred
- Full SCM / Extensions implementations (stubs + activity landmarks only)
- Glyph-faithful minimap
